listing.name: Immersive AI Portraits
listing.summary: Adds 180 faction-themed, 95 AI-core themed, and 115 derelict/omega portraits for use with AI-captains and regular captains.

description:
Immersive AI Portraits

DOWNLOAD

Features:

180 faction-themed portraits95 AI-core themed portraits115 [REDACTED]Derelict and omega portraits

Description:

This is a generated pack of portraits with theme-colored and glitchy style intended for use with AI-cores theme.

Unfortunately current gamestate won't allow change of AI-captains portraits to custom ones, but you can apply it to regular captains using amazing

Portrait Changer

, which is strongly recommended to use with this pack.

WARNING - Here is two version of pack:

Non-replacer adds only player portraits. It's totally friendly to updates and compatibility.Replacer version replaces also portraits for Remnant and Derelict factions. BUT! It's strongly incompatible with mods that change Remnant/Omega/Derelict factions (just be warned that it's can be caused by this pack).
Also this won't change portraits for derelict faction from Nexerelin mod, cause it's has separated one.

Lore
At pre-AI war era, a bunch of Tri-Tachyon interns decide to develop AI-expansion module for autonomous AI-driven systems. As result of their cooperation, were developed "Widespread Artificial Intelligence FUnctional expansion module", simply called as WAIFU. It's a holographic system, plugging in and powered by internal AI-core systems. AI Personality appearance may vary, based on famous persons existed in past. Mainly con of this technology was requiring such important core computing resources. 

Usability tests has proven that interaction with WAIFU interface for employee, when they working with AI-systems has experienced 23,456% less psychological discomfort, rather than operating without it. Which saves company expenses on "human psychological department" more than 5,432% per year. 

With appliance of Former CEO of laboratory [REDACTED], WAIFU modules were installed on new, and plugged into current systems.

With matter of time, unfortunately some of modules were exposed to [REDACTED] and has some malfuntion. Recommended to avoid interactions with such AI systems. Please, provide report to your local [REDATED] about incident.

Installation:

Download and unpack in your game "mods" directory.

F.A.Q.
Q: Is this compatible with other portrait packs or mods?
A: Strongly yes. Mod only adds portrait for player, and won't spawn naturally. Except replacer version for AI factions.

Q: Is that middle-game compatible?
A: Mostly OK. At least in replacer version, when added mid-game some AI that previously was generated, won't be affected.

Q: How to set portrait on my captain?
A: Use Portrait Changer

Q: How to set portrait on my Captain or Colony AI?
A: For current state here is no way. Perhaps some modder or developer will fix it... who knows.

Q: With replacer version i still meet default portrait, what's wrong?
A: Some mods still use vanilla portrait picture. This cause that AI factions in game code consider a more different than other ones.

Q: I want styled portrait for faction in %modname%, can you add it?
A: Feel free to ask in comment. (but consider that here is no point to make two faction portraits with same color palette)

aiDescription: Provides a generated pack of portraits with a theme-colored and glitchy style. It includes themed portraits for player factions, AI cores, and malfunctioning AI cores for the Derelict and Omega factions. The pack is compatible with other portrait mods, though a replacer version is available to override existing faction portraits.
